[SWS_IdsM_00710] Reception SEv with higher priority
Upstream requirements: RS_Ids_00210
⌈Where IdsMEventDisplacementStrategy is IDSM_BUFFER_DISPLACEMENT_-
SEVERITY_BASED, when a new SEv is received and no suitable IdsMEventBuffers is
found and the severity of the new SEv is higher than the severity of at least one SEv
already in the buffer, IdsM shall replace the least severe SEv already in the buffer with
the new SEv.
Note: In case where multiple events in the IdsMEventBuffers have the same least
severity, it is left to the implementer which SEv to discard.
Example: Where the IdsMEventBuffers is 5 and all the buffers are full, when a new
security event is reported, IdsM shall drop the least severe event amongst all
the 6 events.
Rationale: Dropping a security event is inevitable when all the IdsMEventBuffers
are full. In this case, dropping the least severe event minimizes the values of the
security information lost.⌋
